programmes.d: A U.S. tycoon hires an 1880s gunfighter (Jock Mahoney) to find his brother in Mexico.
A cynical former sheriff turned bounty hunter, helps a young, recently appointed acting sheriff with his advice, his experience and his gun.

A cunning Profane Sister Sara recruits a drifter to help Mexican rebels launch a surprise attack on a French fort.
A land baron's (Robert Duvall) gunman (Clint Eastwood) joins a rebel (John Saxon) fighting for Spanish land grants in 1900 New Mexico.
A gun-fighting stranger comes to the small settlement of Lago and is hired to bring the townsfolk together in an attempt to hold off three outlaws who are on their way.
A town marshal (Jock Mahoney) owes his life to an aging gunfighter (Dale Robertson) and refuses to stop him until the debt is paid.
A woman returning to her childhood home is greeted by her bitter father, who rejects her.
A stranger comes to a small town seeking revenge on the man whose testimony sent him to prison.
A genteel woman is horrified at her husband's growing bitterness.
A cowboy faces torture during a Comanche raid on sheepherders.
An Army officer tries to convince Geronimo to surrender.
A woman refuses to let cholera victims die alone in the desert.
A doctor wants to keep his daughter away from a man of which he disapproves.
A rancher objects to Mormons settling in his area.
An old gunfighter finds a wild town is now peaceful and settled.
A Confederate veteran (Rory Calhoun) hunts to kill the five outlaws who ran off his cattle and shot his father.
A gunfighter helps a ranch owner in his attempt to prevent a renegade crew from taking over the territory.
